privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Verno collects, uses and processes personal data when using our website and services.

dataWeCollect.title: 1. Data we collect
dataWeCollect.text: We may collect personal information such as your name, email address, and account-related data when you register or use our service.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose of processing
purpose.text: We process your data to provide and improve our services, manage user accounts, and ensure security and stability.

hosting.title: 3. Hosting and infrastructure
hosting.text: Our services are hosted in Switzerland (Google Cloud, europe-west6). Data is stored and processed within Switzerland.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party services
thirdParty.text: We may use third-party services such as hosting providers and infrastructure services. These providers process data on our behalf.

security.title: 5. Data security
security.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.

rights.title: 6. Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.text: For any privacy-related requests, please contact:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Verno and its services.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.text: Verno provides software for managing clubs, teams, and related operations.

accounts.title: 2. User accounts
accounts.text: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials.

acceptableUse.title: 3. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.text: You agree not to misuse the service or use it for unlawful purposes.

availability.title: 4. Availability
availability.text: We strive to provide a reliable service but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
liability.text: Verno is provided "as is". We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.

changes.title: 6. Changes
changes.text: We may update these terms at any time.
